scripts.title: POV Shift

scripts.title: Cinematic Beauty
scripts.hook: NO TEXT - let visuals speak first 2 seconds
scripts.script: Pure drone footage with subtle color grading, smooth transitions. Text overlay appears at 3s: 'Untouched.' Simple, elegant.
scripts.voiceover: Optional - subtle ambient music only recommended
scripts.caption: Perspective from above 🚁✨ #cinematography #dronelife #aerialview #explore #content

scripts.title: Static Feed Post
scripts.hook: Visual hook only - first 3 frames are key
scripts.script: Use most visually stunning 15 seconds of footage, loop if necessary. Minimal text overlay - just location or one word.
scripts.voiceover: None - feed videos play on mute by default
scripts.caption: New perspective unlocked 🚁✨ Swipe to see more aerial views. Tag someone you'd take with you 👇 #dronelife #aerialview #perspectives #explore

scripts.title: Trending Format
scripts.script: Split screen or comparison: Show ground perspective (use generic reference) vs aerial drone view. Text: 'Aerial view wins? 👀' Vote-style engagement.
scripts.caption: Tell me: This or that? 👇 #dronelife #perspectives #aerial #choose #trend

performance_tips.hooks: First 0.5-1 second is critical. Text overlay or visual surprise within first 3 seconds.
performance_tips.transitions: Smooth cuts between drone angles every 3-5 seconds to maintain attention.
performance_tips.captions: Add captions for 75%+ watch rate (most people watch on mute).
performance_tips.calls_to_action: Include clear CTA - comment, share, tag, swipe up, DM.
performance_tips.best_times: Post 6-9 AM, 12-1 PM, 7-11 PM (time zone dependent)
performance_tips.frequency: Test 1-2 variations per platform first, then scale what wins.
